title: Dell OpenManage Enterprise, versions prior to 4.8.0, contains an Improper Verification of… (CVE-2026-91905)
description: Dell OpenManage Enterprise versions prior to 4.8.0 contain an improper verification of cryptographic signature vulnerability. This flaw allows a high privileged attacker with local access to potentially gain filesystem access. The vulnerability is identified as CVE-2026-91905 and has a CVSS 3.1 base score of 6.4, indicating medium severity.
